Elephant calf left alone after mother's death at coffee estate

An elephant calf was found refusing to leave its deceased mother at a coffee estate in Kodagu, Karnataka. The incident occurred on Tuesday. The calf was spotted by locals and conservationists. Authorities are investigating the cause of the mother's death. The calf is being cared for by wildlife officials.
